text: Huge progress on e-waste recycling in 2025! Visited the newly inaugurated automated hydrometallurgical recycling facility in Greater Noida. 98% precious metal recovery from obsolete smartphones and zero discharge. This is what circular economy looks like! #EWasteIndia #CircularEconomy

Smell of burning toxic plastic and acid wash in Seelampur is unbearable tonight. Despite repeated Supreme Court and NGT bans, midnight burning of printed circuit boards continues in residential gullies. Where is Delhi Pollution Control Committee?
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change issues revised 2025 compliance guidelines for Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) on solar photovoltaic modules and consumer electronics.

Ordered a new refrigerator on exchange under brand EPR take-back policy. Delivery partner flatly refused to take the old one citing no space in vehicle. Customer care has no escalation route. Brands take green credits while citizens get stuck with e-waste!

Proud of our student green club at IIT Madras! Successfully collected over 1.2 tonnes of old laptop batteries, adapters, and keyboards in our January 2025 campus e-waste drive. Diverted 100% to authorized recyclers.
Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) has made dynamic QR-code consignment tracking mandatory for all inter-state transportation of electronic scrap starting April 2025.
Why does Apple and Samsung still glue batteries into smartphones sold in India? The Right to Repair framework must make user-replaceable batteries legally binding by 2026 just like the EU directives.
Kudos to Bengaluru Metro (BMRCL) for placing smart e-waste return kiosks at all Purple and Green line stations. Dropped 3 dead powerbanks today and received Namma Metro smartcard discount points!
Groundwater sampling near informal scrap yards in Moradabad revealed lead and cadmium levels exceeding WHO limits by 1800%. Informal copper extraction is poisoning an entire generation of workers.

State-wise review: Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu lead in formal registered e-waste recycling capacity for FY 2024-25, while Bihar and Jharkhand face severe infrastructure deficits according to CPCB annual report.

Doorstep e-waste pickup aggregator in Pune is a game changer! Booked via app at 10 AM, representative arrived with digital scale at 2 PM, paid fair scrap value, and sent a government-recognized green disposal certificate.

Producer Responsibility Organisations (PROs) are still trading inflated and fictitious recycling certificates on secondary markets. Without physical auditing of recycling plant electricity bills, the EPR portal is ripe for fraud.

Tried to find an authorized drop-off point for discarded lithium-ion drone batteries in Bhopal. Zero authorized bins in a 30 km radius. We are generating 2026 tech waste with 1990 municipal infrastructure.

Inspiring initiative by SEWA organizing 400 women informal waste-pickers into formal e-waste collection cooperatives in Ahmedabad with guaranteed minimum wages, health insurance, and protective equipment.
Notification: National Green Tribunal directs all State Pollution Control Boards to submit geo-tagged inventory of unauthorized e-waste dismantling clusters within 90 days.
Major fire broke out in an illegal battery storage godown in outer Delhi. Dense toxic fumes from burning lithium and electrolyte solvents forced evacuation of nearby schools.
Our IT enterprise completed its 2025 digital asset refresh. Refurbished 650 enterprise laptops, wiped data to DoD standards, and donated them to rural government higher secondary schools in Odisha.

Local kabadiwalas offer 80 rupees for a dead smartphone motherboard, while authorized brand takeback gives a 10 rupee discount coupon on a 40000 rupee phone. Obviously people sell to the informal sector!
Workshop on Circular Economy & Eco-Design in Consumer Electronics scheduled for May 20 at Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. Open to hardware engineers and product designers.
Heartening to see Chennai corporation deploy 15 dedicated mobile e-waste collection vans visiting residential gated communities every weekend. Proper public convenience brings compliance!

Shocked to see young kids in Mustafabad breaking cathode ray tube glass without masks to extract copper yokes. Lead phosphor dust is pure poison. Child labour in e-waste yards needs urgent police action.
Department of Consumer Affairs launches unified Right to Repair India portal listing authentic spare part availability and repair manuals for 35 major electronics brands.
Super impressed by the clean modular design of Fairphone and Framework laptops now shipping to India! If every electronics OEM adopted modular repair, 70% of e-waste would vanish overnight.
CPCB audits reveal that top 10 consumer electronics importers achieved an average of 92% of their 2024-25 EPR collection targets, marking a 30% rise from previous regulatory cycles.
Illegal dumping of broken solar panels and toxic EVA backing sheets along the Sambhar Lake drainage basin in Rajasthan. Zero security and zero remediation from local renewable energy contractors.
Weekend repair cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru fixed 85 blenders, monitors, and audio systems today! Repairing beats recycling, and recycling beats dumping. Keep things in use!
Notice: Annual filing of EPR e-waste returns for producers, manufacturers, and recyclers on the CPCB portal closes on July 15, 2025. Strict penalties for late submissions.
Why are electronics brands allowed to brick perfectly functioning tablets by stopping security updates after just 3 years? Software obsolescence is the hidden driver of the global e-waste mountain.
Awesome corporate collaboration! Tech parks in Hyderabad HITEC City collected over 4.5 tonnes of consumer electronic scrap during Green Tech Week 2025. Handed over to R2-certified recyclers.
Unregulated acid extraction of gold from computer RAM chips in Ghaziabad outskirts continues to dump highly corrosive nitric acid effluents straight into the Hindon river canal.
Guidance document on safe dismantling, storage, and second-life repurposing of retired Electric Vehicle traction batteries published by NITI Aayog.
Delighted with the transparent valuation and instant UPI payout when trading in my old LED monitor at an authorized circular economy kiosk in Mumbai.
Most municipal wet and dry garbage collectors in tier-2 cities have zero knowledge about e-waste segregation. Citizens discard lithium button cells directly into organic waste bins.
Children living within 1 km of informal e-waste dismantling clusters show severe cognitive delays and elevated heavy metal blood toxicity. This demands emergency healthcare intervention.
CPCB imposes 42 crore rupees environmental compensation fine on 6 multinational electronics manufacturers for falsifying EPR recycling compliance certificates.
College campus established a permanent electronic scrap repository. We segregated 500 kg of broken charging cables, mouse units, and circuit boards this semester!
The informal sector should be formalized as green warriors with dignified salaries and high-tech PPE, rather than being treated as criminals. They collect 90% of our waste!
Terrible customer experience trying to utilize brand take-back for obsolete printer cartridges in Jaipur. Showroom staff refused to accept them saying they only sell new items.
Summary of national conference on Rare Earth Mineral Extraction from Electronic Scrap and Urban Mining held at IIT Bombay. Huge economic and environmental potential for India.
Open dumping of old medical monitoring electronics and discarded X-ray tubes near drainage ditch in Patna poses severe lead shielding and radiation hazard.
International E-Waste Day 2025 celebrated with nationwide cyclathons and collection drives across 40 Indian cities. Over 50,000 citizens pledged for zero landfill disposal.
Smartphones designed without headphone jacks or expandable storage force consumers to buy wireless accessories and replace phones faster, compounding the e-waste crisis.
New startup in Gurugram develops automated AI robotic arms to desolder and sort surface mount components from scrap motherboards at 5x human speed with zero toxic exposure.
Toxic smog blankets industrial areas of Loni border due to nocturnal incineration of plastic cable sheathings for copper wire recovery. Residents complaining of burning eyes and throat.
Gazette notification on draft Battery Waste Management Amendment Rules 2025 covering energy storage systems and mandatory recycled content quotas in new batteries.
Excited to participate in the old gadget donation marathon at our housing society in Navi Mumbai! We filled 8 large municipal e-waste bins in just 4 hours.
Brand take-back portals with hidden shipping fees and cumbersome pickup requirements are deliberate friction created to discourage consumers from returning dead gadgets.
State Pollution Control Board seals 22 unauthorized e-waste processing sheds along the Najafgarh drain following drone surveillance of black smoke emissions.
Comprehensive whitepaper on Integrating Informal Kabadiwalas into Digital EPR Traceability Chains published by Centre for Science and Environment (CSE).
Great to see our local electronics retail chain offering 5% instant discount vouchers when customers drop old gadgets into certified in-store recycling boxes.
Severe groundwater arsenic and chromium contamination confirmed near historical informal scrap burning clusters in Shastri Park. Borewells permanently sealed.
Public Notice: Mandatory registration deadline for all refurbishers and second-life battery pack assemblers on the national portal expires on December 31, 2025.
Starting 2026 with a zero-waste pledge! Handed over our household box of 12 dead charging cables, 2 old feature phones, and broken powerbank to authorized e-waste aggregator.
India's e-waste generation projected to cross 2.2 million metric tonnes in 2026 according to UN Global E-Waste Monitor. Our formal recycling capacity must double urgently.
Scandalous that imported luxury tech brands promote net-zero sustainability abroad while maintaining zero functional collection kiosks in entire Indian state capitals.
Brilliant community workshop in Whitefield Bengaluru teaching teenagers how to safely harvest reusable 18650 lithium cells from discarded laptop battery packs for solar projects.
Central Pollution Control Board announces real-time satellite thermal imaging to detect unauthorized night-time wire burning in Delhi-NCR industrial fringes.
Why are replacement batteries for 4-year-old laptops priced at 60% of the entire laptop's second-hand value? Pricing repair out of reach is pure planned obsolescence.
Proud moment: Our cleantech startup in Coimbatore commissioned India's first closed-loop rare-earth neodymium magnet recovery line from discarded hard disk drives and EV motors.
Shocking neglect: Broken street surveillance cameras and discarded traffic signal LED boards dumped along roadside in Lucknow with zero formal asset decommissioning.
Delhi Metro Rail Corporation expands smart e-waste reverse vending kiosks to 50 metro stations. Commuters receive transit fare credits for dropping dead alkaline and lithium batteries.
Informal scrap workers in Moradabad are using cyanide leaching solutions in open tubs to strip gold from printed circuit boards. Extreme environmental contamination emergency.
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) announces standard USB-C charging port mandate for all smartphones, tablets, and wearables sold in India starting June 2026.
Online marketplace trade-in offers are completely broken. Quoted 8000 rupees online for old phone, delivery agent showed up and arbitrarily deducted 6000 citing micro-scratches.
Wonderful school initiative in Kochi! Students gathered 600 kg of non-working electronic toys and gaming gadgets, turning them into STEM educational robotics kits.
National Green Tribunal penalises municipal body for failing to set up ward-level hazardous and domestic electronic waste collection centres mandated under 2022 rules.
Breakthrough in circular electronics: Indian research team at IIT Roorkee develops bio-leaching method using harmless bacterial cultures to extract 95% copper from e-waste without acids.
It is high time Indian consumer protection law enforces 7-year guaranteed software updates for all smartphones priced above 15000 rupees to prevent artificial e-waste piles.
Unchecked illegal dumping of obsolete inverters and lead-acid batteries along Chambal river sanctuary banks. Urgent forest department intervention needed.
Celebrated Earth Day 2026 by hosting a corporate electronics recycling drive. Diverted 3.8 tonnes of server blades and networking gear to certified R2 recyclers.
Most apartment residents in Noida still dump broken CFL bulbs and discarded electronics into the regular household garbage chute. Awareness drives must be mandatory.
Blood tests on 80 informal recycling workers in Seelampur show toxic lead levels 5x higher than occupational danger thresholds. Immediate medical camps and relocation required.
CPCB portal introduces automated blockchain verification for EPR recycling credits to eliminate fraudulent certificate generation by shell dismantling facilities.
Delighted with the doorstep pickup and instant UPI credit received for my old CRT monitor from a verified circular aggregator in Chandigarh. Highly professional!
E-commerce giants deliver replacement consumer appliances in fancy packaging but take zero responsibility for collecting the discarded old appliances. Pure greenwashing.
Standard Operating Procedure for handling and safe scientific recycling of discarded lithium-ion EV battery packs issued by Ministry of Heavy Industries.
Youth volunteer group in Pune created an interactive open-source map of all 85 certified e-waste drop-off kiosks in the city. Citizen initiative driving real impact!
Flames and dense black smoke rising from unregulated plastic casing burning in scrap godowns near Hindon riverbed tonight. We cannot even breathe inside our homes.
Annual review of E-Waste Management Rules reveals formal recycling capacity in India crossed 3.0 million tonnes across 680 authorized dismantling and recycling centres.
The Right to Repair movement is finally taking root in India! Independent repair technicians deserve access to authentic schematics and diagnostic software without OEM monopolisation.
